summary: Goldman Sachs Real Estate Finance Trust Inc filed an 8-K reporting two routine events. Under Item 3.02, on September 1, 2026, the Company sold 189,583.337 Class I shares for $4,732,000 and 147,694.468 Class S shares for $3,724,508 (including $41,008 upfront selling commissions) in its ongoing private Regulation D offering to accredited investors. Under Item 8.01, the Company declared monthly distributions payable September 10, 2026, and disclosed two floating-rate first mortgage loan originations totaling $66.3 million. No special-situation transaction or board recommendation is present.
